verificationCode.body:
Email Verification

Hello, {{name}}!

{{code}}

The code is valid for {{expires}} minutes.

Best regards,
The Nadzin Team

welcome.subject: Welcome to Nadzin
welcome.body:
Welcome, {{name}}!

Thank you for registering at Nadzin store!

Now you can:

  • Buy professional brushes and illustrations
  • Get instant access to files after payment
  • Choose suitable licenses for your projects
  • Receive notifications about new products and discounts

If you have any questions, contact us at support@nadzin.com

Best regards,
The Nadzin Team

passwordReset.subject: Password Reset
passwordReset.body:
Password Reset

Hello, {{name}}!

You requested a password reset. Click the button below to continue:

Reset Password

The link is valid for {{expires}} minutes.

If you did not request a password reset, please ignore this email. Your password will remain unchanged.

Best regards,
The Nadzin Team

purchaseConfirmation.body:

accountCreated.body:
